analysis:
Integration pass over the waitlist feature: the changelog, docs (cli-reference.md, sandboxes.md, two-mac-cluster.md), CLI wiring (Darkbloom.swift registers Waitlist; SandboxCommand and ClusterSetupCommand help text), the gates in ClusterSetupWizardCommand.swift (runOnboarding line 116, requireNewPairApproval) and SandboxSetupCommand.swift (requireApproval first in .fresh), the new FeatureWaitlist client/gate/view/command, and the tests. No concrete regression found.

The waitlist is a client-side product-access gate. It does not touch the provider WebSocket, attestation, App Attest serving authorization (TB-002/TB-009/TB-011, T-052/T-053), encryption, or the prefix cache (T-041). A local owner (ADV-001) can bypass a client gate, so it must not be read as authorization. Real enforcement is coordinator-side and platform-owned, out of scope here.

Security-relevant behavior reported in prior source analyses:
- The A-008 bearer token goes only to https or loopback http. Redirects are blocked, the response is capped at 64 KiB, and there is a 10 s deadline.
- The `[::1]` loopback case likely fails closed, because URLComponents strips brackets.
- Coordinator-supplied text is sanitized to U+FFFD, and --json output is escaped.
- The join body is `{}`, so nothing about the Mac is sent (T-055/T-058).
- A 404 lets setup go on; other errors fail closed.
- Gating applies only to .fresh sandbox setup and to unpaired, non-local cluster setup. Existing installs and pairs are grandfathered.
- The gate runs before any installer download or run, so the TB-013/T-061 installer controls (https-only, 1 MiB cap, shebang check, 0600 script in a 0700 dir) are unchanged.

Coverage limits: the integration replay is incomplete (74 units omitted). I could not confirm the full FeatureWaitlist.swift and WaitlistCommand.swift bodies, the SandboxSetupFlow default for the `waitlist` parameter (it must not default to `.approved` in release code), or the unseen cli-reference.md head hunks (1360-1385, 1635-1727). Please verify these, plus that `darkbloom start` and other pair entry points cannot skip the cluster gate and that the feature name used as a URL path component is safely encoded.
